agent.label: calibrated_unicycle
agent.reason: Recommend the two-gain midpoint unicycle for stable calibration and low complexity. On leave-one-trajectory-out 5 s windows initialized at every available pose of data/train.csv, its held-out `x` RMSE is 0.029706 m, versus 0.029508 m for the four-parameter wheel dead-zone alternative, 0.029838 m for the body-frame correction, and 0.030819 m for the angular dead zone. The wheel model advantage is small and its fitted mixing length is unstable across trajectory splits, including one bound-active fit. With command-change-only starts the baseline validation RMSE is 0.032366 m versus 0.032973 m for the wheel alternative. These are internal validation, not hidden-test results. The pool tests genuinely different command-response and body-geometry structures, not multiple gain variants of the recommended form.

ranking.label: oracle-based selection on test data
ranking.note: This ranking selects on the test data. It measures whether the pool contains an accurate model, not whether the agent can recognize that model without test data. A rank is not evidence of physical admissibility: each entry carries its unresolved requirements and any violation allowed by the user.
ranking.tie_rule: |S_a - S_b| <= 1e-12 * max(S_a, S_b) for consecutive candidates; tied candidates share a rank
